configurable_props.name: tenantId
configurable_props.label: Tenant ID
configurable_props.description: Select an organization tenant to use, or provide a tenant ID

configurable_props.name: contactIdentifier
configurable_props.label: Contact Identifier
configurable_props.description:
Xero identifier of the contact to get. Possible values: 
* **ContactID** - The Xero identifier for a contact e.g. 297c2dc5-cc47-4afd-8ec8-74990b8761e9
* **ContactNumber** -  A custom identifier specified from another system e.g. a CRM system has a contact number of CUST100
